a: A relative noun for the masculine singular.
‘Dhalika’: a demonstrative for the distant masculine singular; the ‘kaf’ in it is for addressing one person.

‘La yahuddu’: he does not urge anyone.
‘The food of the needy’: giving and offering food to him.
Miskin: the poor one whom poverty has humbled.
Wayl: punishment, and a word of warning and threat.
Musallin: those who perform the prayer.

A preposition conveying the meaning of figurative passing-beyond.
Salah: the legislated worship; it is words and actions opened with the takbir and closed with the taslim.
Heedless of performing it in its time and indifferent to it.

The pronoun of the absent (third person plural).
They intend showing off with their deeds.
‘Yamna‘un al-ma‘un’: they refuse to lend what does no harm to lend, of utensils and other things.
Ma‘un: a comprehensive name for household utilities, such as the cooking pot and the axe and the like, of what it is customary to lend.
